internal.title: Incident Report: Checkout Service High Error Rate Resolved
internal.body:
At 11:23 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the checkout service. Initial diagnosis identified the payment service as the primary source of errors, showing a 50% error rate and elevated p95 latency of 120 ms. The frontend service also exhibited a 25% error rate but was inconclusive as the root cause.

The mitigation involved disabling the paymentFailure flag at 11:43 UTC after approval, which led to a rapid recovery and normalization of error rates to 0.2%. The incident was resolved shortly after the flag was disabled.

Key timeline events:
- 11:23:28: Alert received
- 11:43:11: Diagnosis confirmed payment service error injection
- 11:43:18: PaymentFailure flag disabled
- 11:43:18: Recovery verified with error rates normalized

Please review the postmortem for detailed analysis and lessons learned.

external.title: Some checkouts failed temporarily
external.body: Between 11:23 and 11:43 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced issues completing checkout due to internal errors in the payment processing system. The issue was identified and resolved promptly, and normal service was restored shortly after 11:43 UTC. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and appreciate your understanding.
